use_case: Face recognition ('familiar faces') on the 2 entrance cameras: groups recurring faces and sends a named arrival notification for people the owner labeled
vendor_or_model: Cloud video vendor (face recognition model; part of an optional AI features trial)
data_categories: Face images and face templates of everyone entering; names the owner attached to 9 recurring people
human_in_the_loop: Owner received notifications; no automated action
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)) and the FTC biometric policy statement (2023-05-18); Fla. Stat. 501.171 (whether templates generated from video are 'biometric data' under 501.702 is unclear; counsel question)
status: Retired (trial 2026-05-04 to 2026-07-21; deletion confirmed by the vendor 2026-08-12; retired by the owner 2026-08-31)

use_case: Person and vehicle detection alerts: after-hours push notifications with a clip from the rear service area and parking lot cameras
data_categories: Video of people and vehicles; alert clips (no identity inferred)

applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)); Fla. Stat. 934.03 (audio stays off)
